hook: Your boat ride in Odisha can find wild dolphins in a lake.
title: Dolphins Live In This Odisha Lake
description:
Chilika Lake in Odisha is India's largest coastal lagoon. Its brackish water mixes river and sea, and Irrawaddy dolphins live there. Boat trips from places like Satapada are popular for spotting them.

#Shorts #Odisha #Geography
